the genetic susceptibility to inflammatory bowel disease (IBDs).

IBD is the result of a complex interplay between genetic susceptibility and environmental triggers.

the gut microbiome is a major factor in the pathogenesis of IBD and that it can be used as a biomarker to predict disease activity and response to therapy.
